name: procrastimate
description: Add tasks with quick add, see what is due, complete them, and move their dates.
author: smirea

scripts.build: bun run --cwd .. generate && ray build -e dist -o dist

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: Add Task
commands.subtitle: ProcrastiMate
commands.description: Add a task the way quick add reads it: dates, repeats, p1 to p4, #Project, and @label.

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Tasks
commands.subtitle: ProcrastiMate
commands.description: See Today, the Inbox, This week, a project, or a label. Complete tasks, move their dates, or type to add one.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: An AI account token from ProcrastiMate's Settings, starting with pm.

preferences.name: origin
preferences.title: Server
preferences.description: The ProcrastiMate address the token belongs to.

title: ProcrastiMate
